text:
Derek F: Quick help please — corporate card shows a $472.60 charge from Marriott Downtown for "incidentals" after my work trip. I only used room and conference F&B was billed to company PO. I checked folio and it shows a single line "incidentals" no breakdown.
Nora L: Bummer. Did you use the room minibar or pay anything personally?
Derek F: No minibar, no extras. I paid for a client dinner on my personal card (will submit), but the corp card was used at check-in for authorization and afterwards a charge posted.
Sam G: We see a lot of hotels posting pre-authorizations that convert to charges for incidental disputes. Two paths: (1) get full itemized folio from hotel with merchant codes and VAT reg #, (2) if hotel won't provide, AP can do a provisional reimbursement and open a vendor dispute.
Derek F: I emailed hotel folio request (folio@marriottexample.com) and attached my stay confirmation PDF to Concur. They replied: "charge is system incidentals, cannot itemize until audit completes, please await follow-up".
Finance Bot: Policy reminder: Employee disputes for corp-card posted incidentals require an itemized folio or manager written approval for provisional reimbursement. If no folio, charge may be returned to vendor through dispute but timeline varies.
Nora L: Derek, can you confirm manager approval? Also need business purpose for the personal dinner reimbursement when you submit that.
Derek F: Manager Nora approves provisional handling. Dinner was client negotiation meeting (client: Acme Corp). I'll submit separate expense for dinner.
Sam G: OK Nora approves. Derek, for AP to issue provisional credit we need: 1) screenshot of corp card transaction, 2) hotel confirmation, 3) manager approval note, 4) your statement showing posted charge. Upload to Concur under "Corp Card Dispute - Incidentals" and tag `procure` and `ap`.
Derek F: Done — uploaded `marriott_folio_request.pdf`, `card_posting.png`, and manager note in Concur. Marked as `expedite` because my department reconciliation starts Monday.
AP Team Bot: Expedited provisional credits are available for corp-card disputes with manager approval. Expected provisional credit processing time: 3 business days. Final resolution depends on hotel response; if vendor refunds, ledger will be adjusted.
Procurement Bot: We've flagged this vendor account (Marriott Downtown) — procurement will follow up with vendor ops to request folio and merchant breakdown. If vendor refuses, we'll escalate to our account rep.
Nora L: For accounting, if the charge is non-reclaimable VAT we need the hotel VAT number and invoice. If none, finance will classify as `non-reclaimable lodging`. Derek please set GL = 6202-TRAVEL-LODGING. If a portion belongs to client entertainment (dinner) make sure to submit that separately under 6301-CLIENT-ENT.
Derek F: Noted — GL set to 6202. I already created a separate expense for dinner under 6301 and attached receipts.
Sam G: Last piece — please add a short note in Concur: "Request provisional credit pending hotel folio (Ref: FOLIO-3421)". That helps AP match any vendor refund later.
Derek F: Added the note. Any chance procurement can push vendor for itemized within 48h?
Procurement Bot: We'll ping the vendor rep now and escalate if no response in 48h. I'll post updates here.
Finance Bot: If hotel returns an itemized folio later with VAT reg no. we'll attempt VAT reclaim and adjust books. If vendor issues partial refund, AP will apply to the corp card ledger.
AP Team Bot: Concur record received. Provisional credit queued. Expected payout in 3 business days. Dispute case opened: DISC-2025-339.
Derek F: Thanks all — appreciate the fast help. Will follow up if hotel sends detailed folio. :thumbsup:
